summary: SVG rendering received a broad set of accuracy fixes: displacement-map filters can now scale their effect separately on each axis, crispEdges is honored for SVG rectangles rendered by WebRender, and clipping, stroke bounds, and changing overflow are handled more reliably. Bounding-box calculations for SVG shapes and text—including tspan and textPath—were also improved, while keeping geometry calculations independent of pointer-events. These changes help SVG artwork and interactive graphics render and measure more consistently.
